name: MH Performance Analyzer
author: MuerteHorrible
description: Find out what makes Railroader stutter. Start and stop a recording in Preferences > Mods: it records frame times, lag spikes, memory and garbage collection, and how much main-thread time each mod takes. Each session gets an offline HTML report with charts, a spike list, per-mod timing and session comparison, plus a summary and a ready-made prompt to paste into any AI assistant. Reads and writes only its own Output folder.
